messages:
alina: Heads up — p99 latency just spiked ~45% in prod after the v5.2 rollout. Canary at 30% looked OK, full rollout started ~10:07 UTC and we're seeing tails. Traces: https://traces.internal/r/4829. @matt oncall?
jeff: I'm on it. which runtime bits were in v5.2? any kernel/quant changes?
alina: v5.2 includes kernel-selector refactor + continuous-batching tweak and a tiny quantum of optimized-attn for GPU64. commit range: v5.1..v5.2 (d3adbeef..f00bf00d). p95 mostly fine, p99 is the problem.
priya: can we shift traffic back to stable or rollback? this looks like a rollout-caused regression.
matt: I can change rollout weights now. prefer weight shift first to buy time for triage. doing weight shift to 20% v5.2 -> 80% v5.1.
deploy-bot: Traffic split updated: v5.2=20%, v5.1=80% (by matt) at 2026-03-17T10:18:07Z
jeff: collecting flamegraphs + tail traces. from initial look, long marshall/cuda kernel enqueue on small-batch requests. sending a repro harness run against v5.2 now.
alina: also saw increased variance on requests < 32 tokens. suspect small-batch path in kernel selector. adding logs around selector decision.
priya: ok start a bisect plan concurrently. candidate commits: kernel-selector refactor, batching scheduler tweak, optimized-attn enable. we'll bisect those.
matt: lowered v5.2 traffic to 5% -> 95% v5.1 while we triage.
deploy-bot: Traffic split updated: v5.2=5%, v5.1=95% (by matt) at 2026-03-17T10:22:13Z
jeff: p99 already improving from ~480ms -> ~220ms after shift. traces show a 150ms stall inside the optimized-attn CUDA kernel on some device IDs. little to no difference on CPU-run paths.
alina: kicked off perf-harness bisect job: job_id=4829. reproduces p99 tail locally by sending many small requests with variety of sequence lengths. logs pushed: /integrations/traces/4829 and /artifacts/4829/flame.svg
priya: immediate mitigations suggested: 1) disable optimized-attn flag for GPU64 builds, 2) reduce batching window from 20ms -> 5ms for affected pools, 3) temporarily increase worker threads on hot GPUs. I'll open a PR with the toggle and a config change.
matt: if bisect isolates kernel-selector change we'll cherry-pick revert as a hotpatch. for now traffic shift + reduced batch window seems to have stabilized p99.
jeff: bisect plan: test three buckets (A: kernel-selector refactor, B: batching scheduler, C: optimized-attn toggle). run harness per commit in each bucket until we see regression. list of SHAs for automation: ["d3adbeef","ba5eba11","f00bf00d","c0ffeec0"].
alina: sounds good. I'm watching charts and will post final if p99 stays < 300ms. also creating a short postmortem template while we triage root cause.
priya: ETA on PR for toggle: 20–30m. I'll add rollout/rollback playbook steps so oncall can revert quicker next time.
matt: thanks — keeping this thread for updates. if anyone sees new spikes ping oncall and #incidents.
jeff: quick log snippet showing stall:
```
[2026-03-17T10:19:44Z] kernel_enqueue(cuda:GPU64:id=7) took 148ms (batch=8, seq=12) stack: runtime/kernel_selector.cpp:412
```
alina: :thumbsup: continuing to monitor and will update here.
